about.title: About Rumble Challenge
about.description: A tool created to make character team draws easier and more fun, offering different settings, bans, and game modes.
about.footer: Independent project developed for the community.

howItWorks.title: How does it work?
howItWorks.description: Set the number of characters, choose the desired bans, and press the draw button. The system will automatically select a valid team while respecting all settings.

challenge.title: Challenge Mode
challenge.description: In Challenge Mode, drawn characters are added to the global bans after each draw. This means subsequent teams must use different characters.

draw.title: Team draw
draw.description: Automatically generate random teams from the available characters.

drawSettings.title: Draw settings
drawSettings.description: Choose the number of characters and the draw animation speed.

globalBans.title: Global bans
globalBans.description: Remove specific characters from all draws.

individualBans.title: Individual bans
individualBans.description: Define which characters cannot occupy specific team positions.

challengeMode.title: Challenge Mode
challengeMode.description: Prevent characters from repeating between draws by automatically adding drawn characters to the bans.

history.title: Draw history
history.description: View teams that were drawn previously.

languages.title: Multiple languages
